entries.name: AlphaCapture
entries.description: Turning investment language into structured, measurable objects that can be distributed, evaluated and consumed by people or machines.

entries.name: £1 Experiment
entries.description: An exercise in building something stupidly simple that can earn £1. Self-imposed constraints force me to learn the payment process, marketing, trust and, ultimately, what makes somebody decide something is worth paying for.

entries.name: TILL
entries.description: A shopkeeper's handbook for the processes behind online payments — refunds, disputes, failures, access and everything that happens after checkout.

entries.name: Professional Memory
entries.description: A lightweight way for chats, agents and coding sessions to leave behind a useful record of what changed, what was decided and what might be worth sharing.

entries.name: Hop
entries.description: A link that carries value as it is forwarded through people.
entries.shelvedReason: Interesting mechanic; distribution and verification looked harder than the value it created.
